metadata.question: Does the soil moisture in California increase in April 2017 compared to August 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use SMAP or SMOS soil moisture products - Compare two time periods: August 2012 and April 2017 - Location: California state boundary - SMAP started in April 2015, so for 2012 we need to use a different dataset (SMOS or model-based like GLDAS) 2. Masking strategy: - Soil moisture products typically don't need cloud masking - May need to mask water bodies or invalid values - Check for valid data ranges (typically 0-1 for volumetric soil moisture) 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Soil moisture can legitimately be 0 (very dry conditions) - Need to check: * C1: If no images exist for either period * C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after masking * C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or values outside valid range - Compare mean soil moisture: April 2017 > August 2012 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const california = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'California')) .geometry(); const date2012_start = '2012-08-01'; const date2012_end = '2012-08-31'; const date2017_start = '2017-04-01'; const date2017_end = '2017-04-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // For 2012: Use GLDAS (SMAP not available until 2015) // For 2017: Use SMAP const gldas2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H') .filterDate(date2012_start, date2012_end) .filterBounds(california) .select('SoilMoi0_10cm_inst'); const size2012 = gldas2012.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2012 Images: ${size2012}`); if (size2012 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2012.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const smap2017 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture') .filterDate(date2017_start, date2017_end) .filterBounds(california) .select('ssm'); const size2017 = smap2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2017 === 0) { console.log('No data for April 2017.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing const mean2012 = gldas2012.mean(); const mean2017 = smap2017.mean(); // Check pixel counts const count2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: california, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SoilMoi0_10cm_inst').getInfo(); const count2017 = mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: california, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ssm').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 2012: ${count2012}, 2017: ${count2017}`); if (count2012 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation const val2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: california, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SoilMoi0_10cm_inst').getInfo(); const val2017 = mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: california, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ssm').getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 2012 soil moisture: ${val2012}`); console.log(`Apr 2017 soil moisture: ${val2017}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (val2012 === null || val2017 === null || isNaN(val2012) || isNaN(val2017) || val2012 < 0 || val2017 < 0) { console.log('Calculation failed or invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: ${val2017.toFixed(4)} vs ${val2012.toFixed(4)}`); if (val2017 > val2012) { console.log('Soil moisture increased in April 2017.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Soil moisture did not increase in April 2017.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
